val frontmatter_of_content : Base.String.t -> Content_types.frontmatter

Parse just the frontmatter record from raw file content. Returns Content_types.empty_frontmatter when no frontmatter block is present, so a completely empty record (title = "") signals "no frontmatter at all", while a present-but-titleless block yields the "Untitled" default.
